key_idea: Each pass collects a maximal increasing run of desk numbers, so the answer is 1 plus the number of descents in the list.
sketch: Read the desk numbers in form order. Within one pass you can keep collecting signatures as long as the next required desk is further along the aisle, i.e. has a larger number. Whenever the next desk number is smaller than the previous one, a new pass is required. Answer = 1 + count of i with a[i] < a[i-1]. O(K). No pitfalls; desks are distinct.
